Means/std/ranges below 0.24 degree reflect averaging quantized internal telemetry, not proven sub-resolution shaft repeatability. loaded_hysteresis.interpretation: Three full sweep pairs per session were archived before the final-center thermal abort. Signed width is increasing-command branch minus decreasing-command branch at matched command units (center 542 = +10.08 degrees). Values combine dynamics, friction, gravity, compliance and possible backlash. Validation cycle 2 width 0.166 degrees is below the 0.24 degree telemetry resolution. Overall sessions remain incomplete; no negative load data or isolated backlash estimate is claimed.

calibration_and_instruments.mass_radius_measurement_uncertainty: not recorded; operator-supplied measurements, no calibration certificate archived

effective_fit.uncertainty_interpretation: Local Jacobian-based factors conditional on the selected symmetric model/delay and an iid residual assumption. Correlated quantized residuals, thermal drift, fixture calibration uncertainty, and weak armature/damping separation are not covered; these are not population confidence bounds.

training_parameter_mapping.status: provisional_unit_c_low_load_evidence_only; no nominal or randomization config changed

three_unit_comparison.nominal_model_decision: All three effective parameter vectors reproduce C held-out data at about 0.741 degree mean RMSE. A-versus-C improvement is about 0.00068 degree, far below telemetry resolution; no nominal or randomization update is warranted. Armature/damping parameter differences are not independently established physical differences.
three_unit_comparison.interpretation: Three unit-level effective fits are available, but A/B and C use different starting-temperature policies and unit C lacks negative hysteresis. The observed extrema are not a qualified population distribution or deployment torque limit.

limitations: Both campaign manifests remain failed at Q6; no raw status or metadata was repaired or relabeled completed.

Q6 includes three complete signed sweep pairs before a thermal abort in the final-center return sweep. Its loop metrics are partial-session positive loaded system observations, not a completed campaign qualification.
Unit C negative hysteresis Q7 was not executed; no signed load-asymmetry claim can be made for unit C.
Q6 temperatures rise from 34 to 54 C before an inclusive 55 C abort; servo telemetry does not establish thermal equilibrium or continuous duty.
The 55 C abort reading raised before array append; 54 C is the last saved sample, not evidence the abort failed.
Voltage warning 9.508 V recovered to 12.298 V after about 113 ms. No synchronized external artifact identifies bus sag versus telemetry error.
Final torque-off is disabled and read back by capture.py; there is no post-shutdown torque-state sample in the archived NPZ. No independent power-cutoff operation is verified by these artifacts.
Internal health fields are cached and lack per-instrument acquisition timestamps; 50 Hz trace rows are not independent 50 Hz temperature/voltage measurements.
Cooldown target is recorded in the campaign manifest, not in this revision of each capture JSON limits object. Actual cooldown and preparation temperature samples are retained.
Effective total damping does not identify active velocity gain separately from passive drag; kv_sim=0.5 is a retained decomposition convention.
The 4 N m replay limit is held fixed and not a measured servo limit. Torque-speed, braking torque, and passive_active_ratio remain unidentified.
Loaded loop width and signed zero history combine controller response, friction, gravity, compliance, and possible backlash. They do not identify encoder error or backlash activation torque.

WR2 still uses maximum_validated_load_nm=1.0157 as its observation-backlash activation denominator, unlike ToddlerBot independent backlash_activation=0.1. These captures justify neither value; no training mapping change is made.
Ambient temperature, actual current, external shaft angle/torque, and traceable mass/radius uncertainty are absent.

loaded_hysteresis.signed_width_definition: Increasing-command branch position minus decreasing-command branch position at the same transmitted command unit.
loaded_hysteresis.uncertainty: Cycle standard deviation is population-form descriptive std (ddof=0) across only three within-session cycles, not a confidence interval. Center estimates average 0.24-degree internal telemetry; no sub-resolution accuracy, isothermal control, or calibrated absolute angle is demonstrated.
loaded_hysteresis.deadband_status: Isolated mechanical deadband is not identified.
loaded_hysteresis.zero_shift_status: One preparation-neutral endpoint (-0.96 degree) is a history-dependent internal reading, not repeatability or absolute-zero calibration.

records.speed_interpretation: The approximately 23.93 degree/s peak comes from finite differences of quantized internal position, not a measured steady shaft speed or no-load speed qualification.

existing_model_replay.procedure: Unchanged fit.py load_trace/Replay at 2 ms, fixed 4 N m force cap, initial position from the first measurement and initial velocity zero, nominal ten substeps per sample. Requested targets are replayed as in existing fits. No added backlash, target bias, temperature state, parameter fitting, or delay selection.
existing_model_replay.interpretation: Models predict 1.714-1.724 degrees of negative center loop width versus 1.606 degrees measured, a difference below one telemetry step. Friction/controller dynamics already represent much of this loop; adding the full measured width as encoder backlash risks double-counting. This does not prove absence of mechanical backlash. Persistent positive position bias remains uncalibrated.

parameter_mapping.backlash_rad: No new mapping: loaded loop width does not isolate encoder or mechanical backlash.
parameter_mapping.backlash_activation_torque: Unidentified; WR2 exposure reference 1.0157 N m and ToddlerBot independent 0.1 N m are not identified by Q7.
parameter_mapping.target_bias: No mapping from one neutral endpoint or model bias without an output reference and repeatable approaches.
parameter_mapping.thermal_time_constant: Not fitted; 10-second exposure remains a demand diagnostic.

session_split.validation: Complete independently started run05 capture; three cycles. No run05 measurements were used to fit parameters, select delay, or adjust a model.
session_split.manifest_interpretation: Both Q7-only manifests remain partial by design, with Q7 completed and return code zero. Original run01/run02 remain failed at Q6.
session_split.same_conditions: Same fixture/plan hashes, servo identity, 2-degree amplitude, 1 degree/s sweeps, three cycles, 50 Hz nominal sampling, 250 ms move time, 32 C cooldown ceiling, inclusive 55 C abort, and collection revision. Actual cooldown was 31 C and profile temperature 32-43 C in both sessions.
session_split.uncertainty: Six cycles are clustered in two sessions, not six independent sessions. Session means and cycle standard deviations are descriptive, not confidence bounds or sub-0.24-degree absolute output accuracy.

records.width_definition: Increasing-command branch position minus decreasing-command branch position at identical transmitted command units. Center unit 458 is -10.08 degrees, with 13 samples per branch per cycle and 18 common units (450-467). All run05 center widths are negative.
records.thermal_and_electrical_interpretation: The approximately 15.29 C/min slope is over the entire 36.14-second profile, not a full 60-second window. Cached integer-degree temperature and voltage lack per-field acquisition timestamps. No equilibrium, ambient control, true current, shaft torque, or independent supply logging was measured. Successful return/torque-off readback is consistent with completed/null-error capture metadata but is not separately archived; physical cutoff operation is not verified.

model_check.procedure: Unchanged fit.py Replay, 2 ms steps, nominal ten substeps per sample, requested targets, fixed 4 N m cap, measured first position and zero initial velocity. Existing A/B/C models were replayed without refitting, extra backlash, bias, or thermal terms.
model_check.interpretation: On run05, A/B/C predict 1.7129/1.7228/1.7224 degrees center width versus 1.6185 measured. These differences are below one telemetry step, while positive position biases remain about 0.61 degree. This supports retaining the effective model and avoiding an additional full-loop encoder-backlash term; it does not prove absence of mechanical clearance or provide absolute calibration.

parameter_mapping.thermal_time_constant: Not fitted; 10-second exposure remains a demand diagnostic.
